title: Official exchange rates and parallel-market gaps
description:
Central-bank official exchange rates for 25+ countries, each with the bank's own publication date, and for ten countries with a parallel (street) market the gap between an observed real-life indicator and the official rate, rounded in steps (5 points up to 50 %, 10 points up to 200 %, 50 above), with its source and day.

Live data and methodology: fx.sobeinvest.com/for/, methodology. Published by SOBE OÜ (Tallinn, Estonia), the makers of the Currency by SOBE app.
